items.title: Recording comes back on its own
items.body: If Android closes the app while you record, Aorti picks the session back up by itself, in the same file, usually within a few seconds.

items.title: Reconnects when you are back in range
items.body: Walk away from your phone and the notification says the strap is reconnecting. Come back and recording picks up again by itself, with no need to open the app.

items.title: Hourly files on Drive
items.body: Sessions now also save as small hourly files in a folder for each month on your Drive. Each finished hour uploads once, so syncing is faster.

items.title: Faster sync, no duplicate files
items.body: Sync no longer reads every saved session again, and a resumed session no longer leaves a second copy on Drive.

items.title: No more stuck restore screen
items.body: Coming back to the app no longer shows a spinner for up to a minute, and Stop responds right away, even on a weak connection. Long sessions ask before stopping.

items.title: Try the viewer with sample data
items.body: On the home page, click Try with sample data to see what the viewer looks like with two weeks of fake sessions. No sign-in needed.

items.title: Plays nicely with Sleep As Android
items.body: Aorti can share your strap with sleep-tracking apps. No need to disconnect one to use the other.

items.title: Mobile reliability fixes
items.body: Recovers better from brief strap drops, including overnight. Long sessions use less battery.

items.title: Viewer tweaks
items.body: Chills sensitivity slider filters events properly. Sundays open in the week view. HR shifts show in purple so they don't look like chills.

items.title: Save CSV anywhere
items.body: Tapping Export CSV opens a save dialog, so the file goes wherever you pick.
